export_rights.summary: Per the Freshworks Terms of Service, the customer may download or delete its Customer Data at any time during the subscription term; Freshworks strongly recommends exporting all Customer Data before closing the account. After account closure, Freshworks makes Customer Data available for export for 14 days (customer must contact support@freshworks.com within that window and be current on payment obligations).
export_rights.post_termination_window: 14 days from the effective date of account closure

routes.how: Admin Settings > Account Settings > Account > 'Export Data' button. In the dialog, select the time period and the record types to export, then click Export. A ZIP file is sent to the initiating admin's email. An Export History view shows record types, period, status, and initiating admin.
routes.rate_limits: Vendor article: data can be exported up to five times daily, but a full-time-range export only once; a community answer describes the bulk export as available only once in 24 hours
gotchas: Attachments/files are not listed among the exportable record types; whether the ZIP includes uploaded files is undocumented — verify in-tenant
Export is delivered asynchronously by email; time depends on data volume
Docs do not state whether every module (e.g. custom modules, notes, tasks) is covered — the dialog's record-type list is authoritative, verify in-tenant

routes.how: REST API at https://{your_domain}.myfreshworks.com/crm/sales/api (Freshsales Suite). Auth: HTTP header 'Authorization: Token token=API_KEY' using a per-user API key. GET list endpoints (e.g. /api/contacts) plus filtered search (e.g. /crm/sales/api/filtered_search/contact) for server-side filtering; paginate with page/per_page (default 25, max 100 per page).
requires: User API key (found in user profile settings)
routes.rate_limits: Plan-dependent per-hour and per-minute caps under a fair-usage policy (commonly cited baseline ~1,000 calls/hour; one vendor-adjacent source cites 200 calls/minute on Growth); HTTP 429 on breach with X-RateLimit-Limit/Remaining/Reset headers; a paid add-on can raise the hourly limit
gotchas: Freshsales Classic tenants use {domain}.freshsales.io base URLs while Freshsales Suite uses {domain}.myfreshworks.com/crm/sales — confirm which product generation the tenant is on
Exact per-plan limit tables live in vendor articles that could not be fetched directly; treat cited numbers as unverified
No documented dedicated bulk-export API endpoint; extraction is page-by-page over list/filtered_search endpoints

covers: filtered record lists with chosen columns
routes.how: Reports/Analytics: open or create a report for the desired module (e.g. Analytics > Create report, add a widget with the metric such as 'Contacts' plus filters), then click 'Export as CSV' (report level) or widget menu (three dots) > 'Export CSV of tabular data'. The CSV download link arrives by email or via an in-app notification. Filter criteria and exported columns are customizable.
requires: Access to Reports/Analytics; export-report permission (some roles/plans lack the Export report option per vendor community)
gotchas: Community threads indicate there is no bulk export directly from module list views, making report export the practical field-selectable per-entity route

routes.how: Open the record (e.g. Contacts > select contact) > three-dots menu > Export. Exports that single record.
gotchas: Per-record only — not a bulk route; use account export or report export for bulk

preservation_notes.audit_log: Audit Logs live at Admin Settings > Account Settings > Audit Log (Account Admins/Admins only) and track configuration changes (workflows, sales sequences, territories, account/CRM settings) with user, timestamp, and IP, filterable by period/user/module. Documented retention is 90 days. No export function for audit logs is documented — capture in-tenant (e.g. screenshots/scrape) before teardown.
preservation_notes.config_artifacts: No documented export of configuration as restorable artifacts: vendor community threads confirm there is no backup/export for workflows or field configuration (noted as roadmap). Custom-object export covers record data, not configuration. Document fields, workflows, sequences, and reports manually in-tenant.

notes: All vendor-doc claims above were gathered from search-engine renderings of the cited vendor pages rather than the fetched pages themselves — treat nav paths and limits as slightly lower confidence than usual doc-derived recipes and re-verify in-tenant. Honest unknowns: (1) attachments/files — no documented bulk-download route, and the account export's documented record-type list does not mention files (individual attachments are capped at 20 MB per file on upload); (2) audit-log export — viewing/filtering is documented (90-day retention) but no export mechanism; (3) exact per-plan API rate-limit tables exist in vendor articles but numbers could not be read directly; (4) Freshsales exists in two generations (Classic on freshsales.io, Suite on myfreshworks.com) with differing base URLs and module names (leads exist only in Classic) — confirm which one the tenant runs. The 'export all data' whole-account route plus the emailed-CSV report exports are the primary UI extraction surface; email conversations and logs are explicitly included in the account export, which is unusual and valuable for CRM teardowns.
research_caveats: Direct fetches of freshworks.com, crmsupport.freshworks.com and support.freshsales.io were blocked by the research environment's egress proxy, so all vendor-doc claims were gathered from search-engine renderings of the cited pages; exact per-plan API rate-limit tables could not be read directly.
